items.issue: `bim tx new` with a non-concept note (no --concept-type) skips all validation because the note classifies as plain. A multi-line title such as "a\n---\n# b" is written as a malformed note: the title is a quoted multi-line scalar, and the body is "# A", "---", "# b", so the `---` line later parses as the backmatter separator. The draft-validate guard only protects concept, index and run notes.

A named ollama or openai entry without model loads and passes health, then fails every doc call with a raw LLMConfigError. Rejecting it in resolve_doc_route at config load would be cheaper for the user. Not a PRD requirement; the approved design checks the effective model at invocation.

Task 12 fixes executable selection across symlink/.., but still replaces argv[0] with the lookup result. A native executable can use argv[0] to select its behavior. Pass the selected path as Popen(executable=...) and preserve the original argv; extend the regression test to check both values.

The replacement calls os.getcwd() even when shutil.which returns an absolute path. If the launch directory was removed, a valid absolute executable now fails with a raw FileNotFoundError. Call getcwd() only for relative lookup results and test that an absolute executable still runs when getcwd() fails.
